note: Body-map artwork. One flat PNG per workout day type. The app picks a file by `key`; if the file is missing it falls back to rest.png, then to a neutral placeholder.

spec.views: front AND back side by side in every image, front on the left
spec.labels: NONE - no anatomy text baked into the artwork. The app renders its own muscle-group labels.
spec.chrome: no status bar, no home indicator, no toolbar, no title text
spec.size: 1440x870 or larger (front+back side by side), consistent across all 10
spec.framing: identical figure position and scale in every image so they do not jump when swapped
